sources.quote: Steever 1998:274 (Gondi chapter): "Stress, which is non-phonemic, falls on the initial syllable of a word. Gondi lacks a written literary tradition. Recent attempts to reduce the language to writing have generally employed the Devanagari writing system..." Corroborating, Krishnamurti 2003:27-8: "There is no phonemic stress in any of the Dravidian languages. Normally stress (loudness) falls on the initial syllable of a word, short or long."
